changelog:
- Increased the minimum required Aliyun CLI version to 3.3.3; updated installation checks and instructions.
- Added a mandatory step to run `aliyun plugin update` after installing/updating CLI.
- Enforced that all CLI commands must include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-pai-workspace-manage`.
- Clarified installation instructions with direct update command and explicit user agent requirement.
- Documentation updates in installation and usage references; core SKILL logic and security guidance remain unchanged.
